category_title: Confident students seeking agency through co-teaching
scenario_title: Confusion during traditional teacher-led science instruction
minimal_context: The student is listening to the teacher disseminate science content from the lesson plan.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the lesson plan on the board. We are going to go over the science content for today. I will read the definitions, and you need to listen and copy them down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm looking at it, but I don't really get it. We do not always understand the content when the science teacher teaches it just by reading it out loud.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just listen carefully while I explain the steps.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But you explain things but you're not putting anything into it. If I was teaching, I'd explain it using conditions that we can actually understand.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just stick to the lesson plan for now and keep going.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's not working though. Sometimes we would get confused because it doesn't connect to us. It needs to be like us helping us, so we can actually learn it.
